tldr: Immich now makes a birthday memory for each named person with a birth date. It shows photos of that person from past birthdays, from 3 days before the date until its end.
goal: Show users photos of the people they know around each person's birthday, as Memories already does for 'on this day'.

story.heading: Memories now makes birthday memories
story.body: The nightly MemoryGenerate job runs createBirthdayMemories next to the 'on this day' memories, for each user.

story.heading: Memories picks people born that day, and their photos
story.body: forBirthdayMemories returns the owner's named people born on that day. Each memory takes up to 5 photos per past birthday, at most 25.

story.heading: Memory data now names a person
story.body: OnThisDayDto becomes MemoryDataDto with personId and personName. A birthday memory without them is refused.

story.heading: February 29 birthdays move to February 28
story.body: In a year without February 29, isLeapDayObserved makes February 28 the birthday of people born on February 29.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: Memories reads people from the Database and writes the memory. The memory data names the person, and the web and mobile apps title the memory with it.

components.summary: Memory titles now read "{name}'s birthday" for a birthday memory.
The memory model and the sync know the new birthday memory type.
OnThisDayDto becomes MemoryDataDto, with optional personId and personName.
Makes birthday memories each night: picks the people, chooses up to 25 photos and sets when to show the memory.
New queries: people born on a day, the years with photos of a person on that day, and those photos.
MemoryDataDto replaces OnThisDayDto. A birthday memory needs personId and personName.
New birthday memory type, BirthdayData type and isLeapDayObserved for February 29 birthdays.

decisions.title: The same nightly job makes both kinds of memory
decisions.why: Birthday memories use the memory table, the cleanup and the clients that already exist. Only the generation step is new.
decisions.alternative: A separate job and table for birthdays.

decisions.title: Show the memory 3 days before the birthday
decisions.why: showAt and hideAt open the memory before the date and close it at the end of the day, so the user can prepare.
decisions.alternative: Show it only on the birthday.

decisions.title: At most 25 photos, spread over the years
decisions.why: A person with many birthdays gets 1 photo from 25 random years, not only the latest years.

decisions.title: Store the name as it was when the memory was made
decisions.why: personName is part of the memory data. The title does not read the person when the clients show the memory.
decisions.alternative: Read the current name of the person from personId.

decisions.title: Check the person fields in the DTO
decisions.why: A birthday memory must name its person. The schema refuses it otherwise, and replaces the old TODO in create.
decisions.alternative: Check the type and data in MemoryService.create.
